drivers.evidence: Out-of-stock products jumped from 5 to 18 (+13 new). Top 5 newly OOS products alone lost 68 orders.

drivers.title: Competitor Price Gaps on Top SKUs
drivers.evidence: 3 active high-volume products (Electric Kettle, Dish Rack, Spatula Set) are priced 6.9% to 8.3% higher than the lowest marketplace price.

drivers.title: Cancellations & Search Visibility Drag
drivers.evidence: Cancellation rate spiked from 8.0% to 14.0% (seller stock-unavailable 6 -> 14, dispatch SLA 5 -> 9), and search impressions dipped 14.0% as OOS listings lost rank.

already_answered_questions: Was average order value / ASP lower? No, ASP stayed flat at Rs 500.
Was buyer cancellation driving the spike? No, buyer-initiated cancellation rate stayed flat at ~4%; seller-side stock and dispatch SLA drove it.
Are all products down equally? No, 60% of the drop is concentrated in newly out-of-stock products.
assumptions: Orders = placed orders; Sales = placed GMV (Orders x SKU Price).
Cancellation rate = cancelled orders / placed orders.
Causal attributions and recovery estimates are indicative mock model estimates, not guarantees.

cancellations.key_insight: Seller-side stock-unavailable cancellations more than doubled (6 -> 14, from 1.5% to 5.2% of orders) and dispatch-SLA auto-cancellations rose (5 -> 9), while buyer-initiated cancellation rate remained flat (~4%).

pricing.key_insight: 3 active top-selling products are priced 6.9% to 8.3% above the lowest marketplace offer, causing 26 lost orders (Rs 13,000) without affecting overall store ASP.

funnel.key_insight: Impressions fell 14.0% (80,000 -> 68,800) primarily because 18 out-of-stock listings dropped out of search ranking, while conversion fell 1.6 percentage points (12.5% -> 10.9%) due to pricing gaps and stock unavailability.
